parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
The ID of the mongos node in the sharded cluster instance.

> This parameter can be used only when the instance type is sharded cluster.

parameters.name: VpcAuthMode
parameters.description: Specify whether to disable password-free access over VPC. Set the value to **Close**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds modify-instance-vpc-auth-mode --db-instance-id dds-bpxxxxxxxx --node-id s-bpxxxxxxxx --vpc-auth-mode Close --region cn-hangzhou
